text:
Type: shaggy high pile runner
Use: soft strip beside a bed or along a hallway; bedroom, hallway, entryway
Style: contemporary, minimalist
Materials: long dense synthetic shag pile
Colors: dark charcoal grey, cool green-grey cast
Shape: long narrow rectangle with thick fluffy shag, soft edges, solid color, plush
Feel: cozy, soft, grounding
Goes with: white or light grey bedding, pale wood floors, black or chrome accents; modern or minimalist bedrooms and hallways

product.name: GSER
product.description: The high pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
